familyScheduling.before: WASI host request budget exceeded before the second child entered.
familyScheduling.measurementScope: One synthetic native workerd trace pair with temporary request logging. Logging was removed. These counts are not a latency, production or cost benchmark.

allocationFallback.before: growth operation limited, including guest budgets of 8, 16 and 32 MiB.
allocationFallback.nativeCause: Resolved wasmi 2.0.0 StoreLimitsBuilder::trap_on_grow_failure(true) forces memory.grow/table.grow to trap instead of allowing the Wasm failure return.

implementation.scheduling: After the scoped guest turn releases the family semaphore, yield through native Effect scheduling while child fibers remain active. No sleep, priority override, clock cache or custom scheduler.
implementation.allocation: Remove the Wasmi debug trap option and use its native default failure semantics. Memory, table, instance, instruction-fuel, output and host-request quotas remain unchanged.
implementation.nativeRegression: The Rust guest rejects growth by 4096 pages with usize::MAX, verifies unchanged size, then grows by one permitted page and verifies zeroed, writable memory before returning 42.
